newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mulls legal steps to ensure power reliability.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mulls legal steps to ensure power reliability.

text.p: The Clinton administration is considering a plan to provide a legal backstop for industry rules for maintaining a reliable power grid, an Energy Department official said Monday.
The idea is being weighed as part of the administration's legislative plan for restructuring the U.S. electric industry.
"We're looking at whether or not there is a need for a federal law backstop to existing and future industry efforts to maintain the reliabiliity of the system," the Energy Department official said.
